summary: Backend suite: 15/15 passed. Browser checks: 3 passed, 5 failed — all 5 failures share one root cause (frontend crash on any trial-plan admin render).

bugs.title: Admin area crashes with 'Invalid time value' for any trial-plan studio (blocks dashboard, services, schedule, appointments admin, and the post-register redirect)
bugs.root_cause: frontend/src/lib/format.ts formatDateBR() calls date-fns parse(iso, 'yyyy-MM-dd', new Date()) but is fed studio.plan_expires_at, which the backend returns as a full ISO datetime string (e.g. '2026-10-24T12:44:25.991000Z'), not a bare 'yyyy-MM-dd' date. parse() throws RangeError('Invalid time value') inside format(). It is invoked from AdminLayout.tsx's PlanBadge (every /admin/* route renders AdminLayout) and from SettingsAdmin.tsx. Any studio on the 'trial' plan with plan_expires_at set — i.e. every freshly seeded or freshly registered studio — crashes the whole admin shell with Emergent's runtime-error overlay instead of rendering.
bugs.evidence: Browser screenshot /root/.emergent/automation_output/20261010_125440_967/admin-login-dashboard-failure.png shows 'Invalid time value — src/lib/format.ts:25:10' overlay right after a valid login. Console error 'pageerror: Invalid time value' reproduced identically across admin-login-dashboard, admin-services-crud, admin-schedule-editor, admin-appointments-manual, and register-new-studio checks. Backend cross-check (curl) confirms the API itself is healthy and returns the expected trial data: POST /api/auth/login -> 200 {"plan":"trial","plan_expires_at":"2026-10-24T12:44:25.991000Z", ...} — the bug is purely in the frontend date-parsing, not the API.
